step_by_step_procedure: Sum lengths of all outer boundary sides.
formulas_and_identities: Regular n-gon: P = n x s
sub_branches.example_problem: Regular hexagon side 7 cm. Answer: P = 6 x 7 = 42 cm.

step_by_step_procedure: Calculate surface enclosed in square units (sq cm, sq m).
Cutting and re-arranging conserves total area, but changes perimeter.
formulas_and_identities: Rectangle Area: A = l x w
sub_branches.example_problem: Plot 25 m x 12 m. Answer: Area = 300 sq m, Perimeter = 74 m.
